title: unxt
details: Unit-aware computing in JAX, with a Quantity familiar to astropy.units users that passes through jit, vmap, grad, and existing JAX code.
Designed and wrote the package, and leads its development.

highlight.alt: The unxt logo: a ruler crossed with a green pencil on a blue square.
highlight.description: Unit-aware quantities for JAX: they carry their units through jitted, differentiated and vectorized code, with astropy.units under the hood.
